facts.fact: 布伦丹·佩里看到朱迪思办公桌后墙上钉着的一组证据照片
facts.anchor: evidence photos that were pinned to the wall behind Judith’s desk

facts.fact: 布伦丹说那些照片看上去像一块案情板
facts.anchor: That looks suspiciously like an incident board to me

facts.fact: 朱迪思反击布伦丹对她们“业余”的评价
facts.anchor: Amateurs with a track record of catching killers

facts.fact: 贝克斯告诉布伦丹她们拿到了迈克·萨克森的备用手机
facts.anchor: We’ve got Mike’s burner phone

facts.fact: 布伦丹难以置信迈克会有备用手机，说这像他书里写的
facts.anchor: It’s just like in one of his books

facts.fact: 朱迪思当面戳穿布伦丹想证明自己比被选中的塔妮卡·马利克更强
facts.anchor: There’s no shame in admitting how ambitious you are

facts.fact: 贝克斯向布伦丹提议非官方合作，让他独享破案功劳
facts.anchor: We’re not the enemy

facts.fact: 布伦丹终于同意与三人私下合作
facts.anchor: OK, I agree

facts.fact: 布伦丹划定条件：合作不能以任何官方方式进行
facts.anchor: it can’t be in any way official

facts.fact: 布伦丹承认两起谋杀案的调查毫无进展
facts.anchor: We’ve got just about nowhere with both murders

facts.fact: 贝克斯问布伦丹是否听说过四月七日的那场车祸
facts.anchor: Have you come across any kind of car accident on the seventh of April

facts.fact: 贝克斯指出档案失踪说明有人能向警员施压
facts.anchor: it suggests that Gary – or someone who knew Gary – was able to put pressure on a police officer

facts.fact: 布伦丹说勒索加里·怀斯的号码是假的，此路不通
facts.anchor: It’s a fake number

facts.fact: 贝克斯说明备用手机是在霍尔波特真实网球俱乐部的储物柜里找到的
facts.anchor: We found it in Mike’s locker at the Holyport Real Tennis Club

facts.fact: 贝克斯给出备用手机的解锁方式是画字母 F 和 S
facts.anchor: To get past the lock screen, you have to draw the letters F and S

facts.fact: 布伦丹读短信后确认这是勒索加里·怀斯的同一个号码
facts.anchor: This is the same phone number that was used to extort money out of Mr Wise

facts.fact: 苏齐说明是贾米拉·哈利勒告知她们这部手机的存在
facts.anchor: Jamilah Khalil told us

facts.fact: 朱迪思告诉布伦丹塔妮卡当初也说过同样的话
facts.anchor: That’s exactly what Tanika used to say to us

facts.fact: 朱迪思决定抢在布伦丹之前去找塞雷娜·萨克森问迈克的情妇们
facts.anchor: We need to speak to Serena Saxon about Mike’s women before Brendan does

facts.fact: 贝克斯离开时看到花园边一丛紫丁香灌木旁有动静
facts.anchor: her eye caught some movement by a buddleia bush

facts.fact: 贝克斯说不确定看到的东西，只见到一道绿色的闪光
facts.anchor: But I saw a flash of green
